question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What do you think of Ben?

nodes.text: Afraid, Ben shakily signs Spencer's form.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks! The Fist Club appreciates your continued support!
Spencer slams Ben against the locker...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Ooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Geek.
Spencer marches off triumphantly!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I've got to create the Science Club!
Spencer socks Ben in the stomach!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Ooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben doubles over! Spencer brings his fist back for another punch, but at that moment, Principal Shapiro turns the corner. Spencer reacts quickly, releasing Ben and patting him on the cheek...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben, `my very close friend,` for helping me understand my geometry syllabus.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks, Ben, [color=#e23b3b][i]my very close friend,[/i][/color] for helping me understand my geometry syllabus.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Hrrrg...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrrrg...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Spencer! My office! Now! It's the first day, and you're picking a fight?! Are you going to be a discipline problem all year?!
Spencer mutters under his breath.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're lucky... If it wasn't for Crapiro here, you'd be a dead geek.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Are you okay, Ben? If you need to, you can always go to the school nurse...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I'll be okay...
Principal Shapiro leads Spencer off toward her office...
Ben doesn't react!
Spencer's grip tightens! Ben chokes out his words!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay! I'll sign! I'll sign!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pay extra close attention!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I've been dreaming about Fist Club since I was a baby. I've finally come to a school where the administrator is on my side, and I'm not going to let you mess this up for me!
With one hand, Spencer pins Ben against a locker. With the other, he holds up his Fist Club application form.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: In fact, I'm so confident I'll have your support, I'm even going to let you sign my form.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Never!
His grip on Ben tightens!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sign it!
Ben ducks under the punch! Spencer's fist slams into the locker above Ben's head!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `YOW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YOW![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Lucky move!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Faster than you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That hurt my hand!
Spencer lunges forward, this time faster than Ben can react!
He grabs Ben by the collar and lifts him up...
Ben tries to grab Spencer's hand...
But the force of the punch is too strong! Spencer's fist collides with Ben's chest!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oooooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oooooof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Ben crumples to the ground!
Spencer grabs Ben by the collar and lifts him up...
Ben freezes!
Spencer's fist collides with Ben's chest!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oooooof!`
Ben crumples to the ground!
Spencer grabs Ben by the collar and lifts him up...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now let's discuss your schedule, Brent!
A few minutes later, Ben steps out of Ms. Lee's office. He notices the nerds huddled together at the far end of the hall.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If anyone is going to sign my Science Club application, it'll be the nerds!
Ben heads toward the nerds when suddenly Spencer's meaty hand clamps onto his shoulder and spins him around!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where you going, geek?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't have to tell you!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: See, that's where you're wrong! You tell me whatever I want to know, or you'll have to tell it to my fists!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, what do your fists like to talk about? The Theory of Relativity? Occam's Razor?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Which is it? Do you want me to talk or shut up?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr! How about `this?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Grrr! How about [color=#e23b3b][i]this?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer throws a heavy punch!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Darwinism? In my experience, `ism`'s are always boring!
nodes.text_bbcode: Darwinism? In my experience, [color=#3b78e2][i]ism[/i][/color]'s are always boring!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This one isn't! In fact, Darwin invented the idea of 'Survival of the fittest'! He theorized that life adapts in order to survive!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Hmmm... The same way that nerds develop hiding places in order to avoid hallway altercations with people like Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Think of nature as the original Fist Club! Only instead of guys and their fists, imagine elephants and their tusks, lions and their teeth, snakes and their venom!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Men and their beards!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Fist Club sounds like frolicking in a park compared to Science Club! Plus, I love men with prickly faces!
Ms. Lee signs Ben's form!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Uh huh... I understand that it is `possible` to create explosions, but that's usually not the purpose of science. Right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh huh... I understand that it is [color=#3b78e2][i]possible[/i][/color] to create explosions, but that's usually not the purpose of science. Right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, no. But, scientists `are` clumsy. Spills happen all the time! And those spills can cause accidental explosions!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, no. But, scientists [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] clumsy. Spills happen all the time! And those spills can cause accidental explosions!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Think of it this way... Science is like watching a car race. You're just sitting there, waiting for the cars to crash!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Hmm, I do love car races! But, I think car races are a big leap from Science Club! Racecars crash all the time, but how often does a spill in a lab actually cause an explosion?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... Not that often... To be honest, most spills just create a discolored mess.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: See? I knew science was boring!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So you won't sign my form?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: 'Fraid not. I just can't support a club that, at its most dangerous, creates a discolored mess.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You might want to work on your sales pitch.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think my chicken voice is coming in. I'm looking forward to squawking...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Just make sure you don't let anything get in the way of your grades.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: This is your junior year. The grades you get this year will be what all the colleges look at.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... A sophomore.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Oh, is that so? Well, uh, your sophomore year is just as important.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I remember my sophomore year... I was president of the Science Club! First sophomore president the Science Club ever had!
Ben's father resumes typing...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Really? Wow. Maybe if I...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Hmmm-mmm?
Ben's father doesn't look up.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: How hard is it to tell grape from apple? Has the man never encountered a fruit basket?
Ben sighs...
The typing stops...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At the end of last year, my grade almost slipped because of the tension between my lab partners.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: You still got the A+!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I did... But my team didn't make it easy.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: You think Professor Dean makes `my` job easy? Other people slow you down. I'm glad you're learning this now!
nodes.text_bbcode: You think Professor Dean makes [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] job easy? Other people slow you down. I'm glad you're learning this now!

nodes.text: The typing stops...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: What kind of question is that? What you do is work hard! You work day and night if you have to, and you get those grades.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: You already knew that though. You always get straight A's.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I do...
Mr. Kale stops typing and immediately looks at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: What? Why not? Are you feeling okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Have you even heard one word I've said?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What did I say?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Well, I didn't hear `all` of the words exactly. But I did hear that you won't be able to go to school.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I didn't hear [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] of the words exactly. But I did hear that you won't be able to go to school.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was kidding about that.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Oh... Don't do that.
Ben's father resumes typing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How can I keep my dad's attention...?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad, do you have any advice on...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: That's really cool.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm wondering if I should join them or fight them. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: You probably shouldn't get into any fights at school...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good tip. There is one problem, though...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Uh huh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This ought to get his attention...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If the aliens abduct me, I might not be able to go to school!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: That's a funny story.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've been really adjusting to all my new feathers.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Everyone goes through changes. Girls mature faster than boys.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I laid an egg yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Cool. What else?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This ought to get his attention...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think when I become a full-fledged chicken, I won't be able to go to school!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So then the, um, quarterback... Dodges the linebacker... And throws it to the... Wide receiver guy... For the touchdown?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Pretty good. What do you think, Jacob?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I still don't think he knows anything about football...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But for a nerd that was pretty impressive.
The football team signs Ben's form!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'd better see something cool from the Science Club out of this!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You got it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I don't have nearly enough signatures!
He steps into Ms. Lee's office...
Ben has failed...
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: A what gun?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A sonic gun! A gun that uses sound as a weapon! Think about the power you could wield...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Awesome! I want a prototype by the end of the week!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uhh... That's pretty soon...
Ryan signs Ben's form!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: A deal's a deal, Ben. Just get it done! And don't welch!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Big mistake! You can't give power to a guy like him! Trust me! I know!
Later, in Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Congratulations! Science Club is official!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great!
In P.E. the following week...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Psst! Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right here! A deal's a deal!
Ben hands Ryan an enormous, futuristic weapon.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You are definitely my new favorite person. I'll make sure to give you a seat in the Royal Empire!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks! The... What was that?
Ryan flips a switch on the gun! It hums to life!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: All right! Listen up, everybody!
Ryan fires the sonic gun, blasting a gargantuan hole in the gymnasium wall!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sweet...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: P.E. is officially canceled! All the nerds and ugly girls report for work creating a statue in my honor!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hot chicks, you're now a part of Ryan's Dance Team! You dance, I watch!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Don't worry, buddy! Like I said, there's always a place for you as my right hand man. Dance Team, please get some grapes for my buddy!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What have I done?!
That got out of control in a hurry, didn't it? Why don't you go back and see what happens if Ben doesn't give Ryan ultimate power!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: See? Lame club, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It would do all the things a human girlfriend does... And I guess it could also be a bodyguard...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And it could probably have some storage space in it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I could probably...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Dude, stop! Stop! Stop! You had me at 'robot girlfriend'.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It will, of course, take some time...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't care! Just do whatever it takes!
Ryan signs Ben's application form!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You little punk! I'm gonna...
Ryan steps in front of Ben, rolling up his sleeves.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: You wanna get to him... You're gonna have to go through me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're... You're... You're betraying me?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `Dude!` Robot. Girlfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Dude![/i][/color] Robot. Girlfriend!

nodes.text: Spencer stands there fuming...Then he turns and storms out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Ryan!
Ben takes off for Ms. Lee's office!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm so happy!
Ryan whistles as he resumes cleaning...
Meanwhile, Ben barges into Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How am I going to get a signature when there's no one left at school?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... There are still students here... The students who got detention!
Ben cracks open the detention room door and finds Ryan dusting by himself.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I hate school! I always end up having to clean something!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ryan?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Huh? What are you doing in here?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Here goes nothing!
Spencer barges into the detention room!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't listen to him! Don't sign anything!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude, the geek and I are both trying to get signatures for our clubs.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But his club is lame and mine is awesome. I'm one signature short from founding `Fist Club!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But his club is lame and mine is awesome. I'm one signature short from founding [color=#e23b3b][i]Fist Club![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: A club for fighting?! That does sound pretty awesome!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sign my form!
Spencer thrusts his form in Ryan's face! Ryan takes the pen from Spencer's hand and...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You haven't heard about my club yet!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: What's your club, geek?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Science Club...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: That... Does not sound very cool.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Just sign mine then! You'll get to fight `without getting in trouble!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just sign mine then! You'll get to fight [color=#e23b3b][i]without getting in trouble![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Tough to beat that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Er... But don't discount Science Club... We could build you a...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess this idea makes up for the whole fat debacle.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, like, you could have signs that say 'Vote Cheerleader in 2011.' Or... 'Never fear, cheer is here!' Or... 'Cheerleaders are rah rah rah-sponsible!'

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's a horrible idea!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, those are just bad examples...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! Well... Yes, the examples are bad. But it's a horrible idea because it takes the focus away from the team's star, `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! Well... Yes, the examples are bad. But it's a horrible idea because it takes the focus away from the team's star, [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There are going to be guys running for Homecoming King, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, pair up each of the girl cheerleaders with strong male candidates. Amanda with Hector, $ZOE with Howard, you with...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, whomever you wish.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oooh... I like the sound of that. Taylor and... Some hot guy! The King... And Queen Taylor, her cheerleader minions in tow.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Minions?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh! Fine! `Princesses` in tow.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh! Fine! [color=#3b78e2][i]Princesses[/i][/color] in tow.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `YAY!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]YAY![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Let's see just how helpful you really are. Homecoming is just around the corner...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you want to get ready for the big game! I understand! I've already thought of ways to restructure your pyramid, which seems a little bottom-heavy!
The cheerleaders gasp! Hector surreptitiously shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm only going to say this once! `No one` touches the pyramid. Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm only going to say this once! [color=#3b78e2][i]No one[/i][/color] touches the pyramid. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yikes... Got it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And when I say 'Homecoming', I'm not talking about the game! I'm talking about Homecoming Court!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But aren't you a shoo-in for Homecoming Queen?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course! But this year I want an `all-cheerleader` Court for Homecoming Queen!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! But this year I want an [color=#3b78e2][i]all-cheerleader[/i][/color] Court for Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Me, Jessica, Amanda, Maria, and $ZOE! The voting starts soon!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really, Taylor? I'm on your list? Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yes. Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So, can stupid boring science help or not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um... I don't know how much `science` can help, per se. But `I` can help!
nodes.text_bbcode: Um... I don't know how much [color=#e23b3b][i]science[/i][/color] can help, per se. But [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can help!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you want to have an all-cheerleader Court, you could...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Advances in dietary science when applied to athletic teams can drastically improve performance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In other words, you're calling my cheerleaders fat!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: He did not!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: He did!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My head hurts.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait a sec, didn't I hear you calling them fat when I walked in? What's the difference?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The difference is... My girls `expect` me to insult them! It's called `motivation!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The difference is... My girls [color=#3b78e2][i]expect[/i][/color] me to insult them! It's called [color=#3b78e2][i]motivation![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But when it comes from you, a nerd no one even recognizes, it's `cruel!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But when it comes from you, a nerd no one even recognizes, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]cruel![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now get out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... Taylor, maybe we should hear him out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hear him out? He just called you fat!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe he didn't word it right... But if he thinks science can help our team, maybe we should listen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember what happened when Dex made that Tackling Robot for the football team?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Four policemen ended up in the hospital?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that too... But our defense got way better!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hmmm... You do have a point.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Apology accepted. Clumsy as your tact was, I'm definitely interested in anything that can improve my girls' performance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, we could probably work toward making a cheerleading uniform that wicks away sweat!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So my cheerleaders won't look like shiny zombies?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's the idea!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do we have to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whatever it is, I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love science now!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shush! Promises of sweat-free attire don't completely make up for crashing my practice!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Help them what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Lose weight?
Afterward, Denni pulls Ben aside...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks for trying to cheer me up today, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think I'm going to talk more with Sam about maybe figuring out what's going on with Colt...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to do this? I mean, I'm sure Colt can take care of himself, and he's not exactly the nicest guy...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know... It's just...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess you've still got feelings for him, huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I know it's stupid, but I do.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, good luck with Science Club.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks. There's really only one group left to talk to.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The cheerleaders... I was going to talk to them at practice...
Sam overhears...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're going to interrupt a cheer practice! Ha! Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll convince them. See you later, Ben.
Sam and Denni leave the cafeteria together... Ben looks on.
After class, Ben finds the cheerleaders practicing in the gymnasium.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm disgusted with all of you! Every one of you is out of shape! You ate too many hot dogs this summer!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And why do all of you look so... Sweaty and gross?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's hot in these uniforms!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to melt!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uck! I'm sweating! Hector, don't look at me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's hard to see `anything` with all this sweat in my eyes!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's hard to see [color=#e23b3b][i]anything[/i][/color] with all this sweat in my eyes!

nodes.text: Taylor notices Ben and storms over!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you doing in here? This is a closed practice!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I need the cheerleaders' help!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Too bad! Get out! I can't have my girls feeling self-conscious about how they look!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I can help them feel better about their appearance!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you saying? And be very careful, new nerd!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm trying to start a Science Club!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! I'm so shocked with joy!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Get to the point!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Science Club could help the cheerleaders out...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Science Club? Could anything be more boring?! I want to make them better cheerleaders, not better sleepers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But discoveries in Science Club could help them...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Bad idea... We could also, um, build a new swimming stadium!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That sounds expensive!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hmmm, it does... What if I could attract the cheerleaders to the meets, increasing attendance, and thus improving your performances via school spirit!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: First, that has nothing to do with science. And second, the last thing I want to see while I'm doing the backstroke is Taylor's face!
Ben sighs...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Linda? Interested?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Improved swimming or not, I've already made my choice, and I'm sticking to it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, how?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We could design sleeker uniforms...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You just want to check us out.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Really? How?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If Science Club gets formed, Fist Club doesn't!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Fist Club! That's so like him! I'd sign your Science Club form twice if I could!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll sign! He's the reason we're low on funds! 'Protection' he calls it.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That guy's ugly. And you look a lot better with that haircut. I'll sign.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Er... Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll sign too. Spencer's a jerk!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Linda? I know you said you're trying to be decisive, but...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Everyone's signing?! What do I do?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Ben hands her the form and his pen. Linda signs.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good. Good. I think I made the right choice.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You already know how I feel about you!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Come on...
Ben and Denni walk over to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sam?
Sam turns and faces Denni.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? Have you come to gloat because you made out with Colt again or something?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No! I... I thought you two were together again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We aren't. But it's not like that stopped you before...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, could you just tell him that he doesn't have to avoid me? I'm not going to get in the way of you guys if it means him avoiding me altogether.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why would he avoid you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I did see him at school over the summer, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt came to school in the summer?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Willfully, too, if you can believe it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, he was acting really weird, and then when he didn't show up to our class today I thought maybe he was cutting class in order to avoid me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think he's here today!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Colt missing a day of school...? That doesn't seem like a big deal...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It isn't... It's just... I think he might be gone. Like, `gone` gone!
nodes.text_bbcode: It isn't... It's just... I think he might be gone. Like, [color=#3b78e2][i]gone[/i][/color] gone!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why do you think that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because I went to his place last week... And it was completely empty!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I thought maybe he had just moved without telling me... But if he's not at school...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! I think this is `serious!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! I think this is [color=#3b78e2][i]serious![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I do too...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Where do you think he is?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He could be anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can call my Uncle! He's good at finding people!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is he like a cop or something...?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, right... Sorry, Ben.
Denni addresses the entire table...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Would the swim team be interested in supporting Ben's Science Club?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Science Club? I don't think so. When's the last time anyone saw a hot scientist?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sorry... I'm trying to be decisive this year, and I'm not interested in science. At least I don't think I am...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? You sure?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, she might not like you very much, but if it's important, you'll have to be strong and talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sure, talking to the girl whose boyfriend I kissed. This ought to be fun.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You did say you brought her cookies.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I don't know how much she actually appreciated them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure they were good enough to forgive a little. And maybe the gesture helped too.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks. I think that's what I needed to hear.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you did kind of...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All I'm saying is not only did you kiss her boyfriend, you were also flirting with him at the Prom.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I think I have to talk to her anyway...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, then why did you ask?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Because I thought you might reassure me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Now I just feel like that horrible 'other woman' come to ruin Sam's world yet again...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure it's not that bad.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just... Let's stop talking about it. It's not really helping.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The quarterfoot shoots it across the wide line near the penalty box. Then, um, he makes a touchgoal. And everyone cheers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, and there's a receptionist who catches... Phone calls?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow. That was worse than when Brendan talked about kicking the ball into the goal...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That actually hurt to listen to...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, so I don't know anything about football... That doesn't mean Science Club can't help!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You can't help something you don't understand!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Ben. Good luck...
Jane sits down next to Denni, along with a bunch of the other members of the environmental club, W.H.A.L.E.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know what's really stupid?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No... What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A scientist in a shoe store.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because he can't find a pair of `beakers` that fit.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because he can't find a pair of [color=#e23b3b][i]beakers[/i][/color] that fit.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Beakers. Sneakers. Get it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh. Heh. That was `really` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh. Heh. That was [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was... And you know what's even stupider?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That it got you to smile.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hahaha... Okay, you made your point.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your problem can't really be that stupid. Come on!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's nothing, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you get Ms. Prez for English? I hear she's hard.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No, it's not that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Something at home?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: A guy?
Denni sighs...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe... Just... Please drop it, okay?
The bell rings, and the nerds rush to class...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah! If I'm going to get 'A+'s I should probably get to class on time!
Ben sits in class and looks over the signature sheet as the rest of the students file in.
Denni sits down in the seat next to him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ben?! Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes? Why?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just didn't recognize you with that haircut... It looks really good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Thanks!
Denni lets out a small sigh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's stupid, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wonder if I can cheer Denni up...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: He made you sign a form for a club that's in direct competition with yours! That kind of toughness can't be taught!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wish there was a toughness class. I'd take that instead of algebra!
Erik begins acting out a scene...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, I do not know how to calculate the length of the side of an isoceles triangle. That information is useless when you're a black belt! `Hiyaaa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I do not know how to calculate the length of the side of an isoceles triangle. That information is useless when you're a black belt! [color=#e23b3b][i]Hiyaaa![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Not that tough? He's the toughest guy on campus!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I heard he once ate an entire pizza in one sitting!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How does that make him tough?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Tough guys eat recklessly!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Besides, he just attacked both of us without breaking a sweat!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: He isn't?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... How would he?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Couldn't he just take your form from you and read it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on! We're talking about `Spencer!` When is he ever going to read anything?
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on! We're talking about [color=#e23b3b][i]Spencer![/i][/color] When is he ever going to read anything?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's a good point! Last year, I saw him standing right under a 'No Loitering' sign for like thirty minutes, but he wasn't doing `anything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's a good point! Last year, I saw him standing right under a 'No Loitering' sign for like thirty minutes, but he wasn't doing [color=#e23b3b][i]anything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not sure that counts...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No offense, Benjamin, but I know loitering when I see it. After all, I `am` a Junior Detective!
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, Benjamin, but I know loitering when I see it. After all, I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] a Junior Detective!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Okay, Ben! I'll sign!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great! Thanks, guys!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where's Brendan? I could have used him against Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ever since his break-up with Dinah, he's been spending time by himself...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Anyway, you were headed our way before that lugnut showed up. Something we can assist you with?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Space 'Splosions trivia time, perhaps?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I was hoping you could sign my application form for Science Club!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Science Club?! Awesome idea! I can't believe I didn't think of it first!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love science, Benjamin, but we can't sign your form.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We already signed Spencer's!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He forced you guys to sign too, eh?
Dex rubs a bruise on his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: In his special way.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He didn't have a chance to get rough with me! I signed just because I love new clubs!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's okay. There's nothing in the rules against signing both of ours.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay, guys. There's nothing to fear. Spencer is...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm fine. I'm just happy I dodged that punch!
The nerds run over to Ben!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We saw the whole thing!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: I was `just` about to come over and help you!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [i]just[/i] about to come over and help you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I wasn't! Safety is my top value!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I failed... And I don't fail at anything...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. You can come to a Fist Club meeting anytime!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: He can be so sweet...
The future. Fist Club has been established. School is no longer a place of learning. It is now a place of battle!
The bell rings for school, but there's no movement...
Ben and Erik inch their way around a corner and take a quick peek down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Empty.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hate it when its empty!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We just have to get to the end of the hall, and then we'll actually be able to attend chemistry class!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just want to learn!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah. Wait. Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I don't make it, tell Prissy I would have been a really good boyfriend for her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's sweet, Erik... But you're going to tell her that yourself! Come on!
Ben and Erik turn and sprint down the hall!
Zach emerges from behind a locker and tackles Erik!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Zach sack attack!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Ack!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ack![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Leave me!
Ben turns back toward the chemistry class door, but he runs right into Spencer's broad chest!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice try, geek.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Make it quick.
Spencer cocks his fist back... Ben closes his eyes...
Spencer won? That's definitely not the outcome Ben was hoping for! Play again and see if you can help Ben beat Spencer and create the Science Club!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Hello, Ben! Did you get the signatures?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I did. Here!
Ben hands the form to Ms. Lee. She looks it over.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Very impressive!  I didn't think you had a chance!
Just then, Spencer barges into Ms. Lee's office!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I got it! I got the last signature.
Ms. Lee inspects Spencer's form.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Spencer. You're not allowed to sign your own form. Besides, you're too late... Ben beat you to it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! Fist club! My baby dream!
Spencer glares at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You little...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, what a friendly competition! Ben, you are free to go and congratulations! I hear there's a Science Fair coming up... Might be a good chance for your new club to flex its scientific might!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Lee.
As Ben walks past Spencer, Spencer mutters under his breath...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We're not done. Not by a long shot.
That night, Ben comes home feeling ecstatic about creating the Science Club!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't wait to see the look on Dad's face!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad! Guess what I...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why is it so dark in here?
Ben's stomach drops the moment he sees his father's sad posture, his head buried in his hands...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Son...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Your mother just filed for divorce.
Whoa! Ben's parents are getting divorced! What does this mean for Ben? Find out in the upcoming episodes!
In the meantime, you played a `great` game! You beat Spencer against all odds and managed to create the Science Club! And all on the first day back!
nodes.text_bbcode: In the meantime, you played a [b]great[/b] game! You beat Spencer against all odds and managed to create the Science Club! And all on the first day back!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: That's nice...
Ben's father's phone buzzes on the table, but he continues typing.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad? Aren't you going to get that?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Uh huh. In a second...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it could be from Mom...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: If it's your mother, she'll call back.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's been in New York visiting Aunt Jenny, don't you think you should...?
But the typing continues...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Never mind.
That night, Ben lies awake in bed...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad was so distracted tonight... The only thing that got him excited was talking about being president of the Science Club...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I became president of the Science Club, maybe it'd give us something to talk about. Something I was a part of that mattered to him more than grades...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But how am I going to do that? The school doesn't even `have` a Science Club! Unless, of course...
nodes.text_bbcode: But how am I going to do that? The school doesn't even [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] a Science Club! Unless, of course...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...I create it!
The first day of school! Before the first class, the hall is filled with students catching up on their summers and complaining about their new schedules.
Ben marches past them and into the counselor's office...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ms. Lee, I...
Ben stops when he sees Spencer sitting opposite Ms. Lee!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here? Detention's down the hall.
nodes.text_bbcode: What are [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] doing here? Detention's down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm starting a club!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What kind of club could you possibly be interested in?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's a club where guys will be able to `fight` each other, like, a `fighting` club for `fighting.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a club where guys will be able to [color=#e23b3b][i]fight[/i][/color] each other, like, a [color=#e23b3b][i]fighting[/i][/color] club for [color=#e23b3b][i]fighting.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm calling it `Fist Club!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm calling it [color=#e23b3b][i]Fist Club![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unsurprisingly, you've created the most unintuitive name possible. And Ms. Lee's not going to let you start a club where you fight!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: As a matter of fact, I've just given Spencer permission to pursue his Fist Club, provided of course that he obtains enough signatures on the application form.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?! How can you permit this?! Fighting isn't allowed in school!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And yet, we have fights all the time! Spencer's convinced me that physically expressive students like him `need` an outlet for their anger.
nodes.text_bbcode: And yet, we have fights all the time! Spencer's convinced me that physically expressive students like him [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] an outlet for their anger.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Fist Club's mission is to reduce school-wide anger and ultimately, reduce school-wide fighting. Can't you see the value in that, Brent?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My name is Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Sorry. Must be that haircut... You look like a Brent now.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Starting Fist Club will encourage students to fight `more.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Starting Fist Club will encourage students to fight [color=#e23b3b][i]more.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I don't think that logic follows...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why are you arguing against it so much? If anything, Fist Club will `help` you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Why are you arguing against it so much? If anything, Fist Club will [color=#e23b3b][i]help[/i][/color] you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?! How?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well... I won't be punching your face in if I'm busy punching other guys' faces in Fist Club!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: That's very thoughtful of you, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh! It was! Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Why are you here again, Brent?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My name is Ben! And I... Well, I also wanted to start a club.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Ooh! How cute! A club competition between friends! What kind of club?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Science Club.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nerd.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: That `does` sound pretty nerdy. Also, I'm not quite sure how Science Club will prevent fighting.
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] sound pretty nerdy. Also, I'm not quite sure how Science Club will prevent fighting.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not trying to prevent fighting!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Then I don't understand the purpose of your club.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Science! It's in the name!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No need to get testy. You'll never win against Spencer with that kind of attitude.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not that you had a chance.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Win? Can't we just each get signatures and form our clubs independently?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm afraid not. As I was telling Spencer earlier, the school only has the budget for one more club.
Ms. Lee slides a club application form across her desk to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Looks like you and Spencer are in a race! It's survival of the fittest! Whoever can come to me at the end of the day with a full sheet of signatures gets their club made!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Spencer, you may go! Ben, we need to discuss your class schedule!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? How is that fair?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't be such a baby.
Spencer shoots Ben a wicked grin as he leaves Ms. Lee's office...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Spencer's right. Maybe instead of complaining about it, you could try to be more resourceful...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I see... In that case...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ms. Lee, would you sign my petition?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well-played, Brent... I like that..

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But tell me, why would I sign? What's so good about Science Club?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What would Ms. Lee love about science?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, Ms. Lee, the great thing about science is that you get to...
A little while later, Ben sits down next to Denni in the cafeteria for lunch...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How you feeling?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay...
Sam and the rest of the swim team sit down at a nearby table...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Can I ask you about something?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sure. Anything.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I don't know if I should talk to Sam. See, it's... It's about Colt.

nodes.text: I don't know... To be honest, I'm worried that Science Club would drain money from the school budget that would otherwise go to the swim team.

nodes.text: I got it! I got the last signature.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Spencer. You're not allowed to sign your own form. Besides, you're too late... Ben beat you to it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! Fist club! My baby dream!
Spencer glares at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You little...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, what a friendly competition! Ben, you are free to go and congratulations! I hear there's a Science Fair coming up... Might be a good chance for your new club to flex its scientific might!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Lee.
As Ben walks past Spencer, Spencer mutters under his breath...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We're not done. Not by a long shot.
That night, Ben comes home feeling ecstatic about creating the Science Club!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't wait to see the look on Dad's face!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad! Guess what I...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why is it so dark in here?
Ben's stomach drops the moment he sees his father's sad posture, his head buried in his hands...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Son...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Your mother just filed for divorce.
Whoa! Ben's parents are getting divorced! What does this mean for Ben? Find out in the upcoming episodes!
In the meantime, you played a `great` game! You beat Spencer against all odds and managed to create the Science Club! And all on the first day back!

In a coffee shop, Brendan connects to the internet on his laptop...
I know I shouldn't look at Dinah's Faceplace page, but I can't resist!
Brendan navigates to Dinah's page and finds...
These are new pictures! And she's in a disproportionate number with that Adam guy!
Taylor steps into the cafe and notices Brendan, but she can't see his laptop screen.
What's the matter, Brendan? Upset because you realized how much life you've been wasting playing those video games?
Something like that...
I don't understand you gamer nerds! So you get a high score? It's not like anyone cool ever sees it!
M.M.O.'s don't really have high scores... And I'm not playing right now.
Oh yeah? What are you so sad about then?
I... I just found a bunch of pictures of Dinah on Faceplace with another guy.
Whoa! Didn't you guys like just break up?
Yeah, we did.
I didn't know breaking up would hurt this much.
Break-ups hurt a lot!
Taylor looks around and lowers her voice...
Remember when we got trapped by Dyre, and I told you about my first kiss?
With that Chuck guy right? You sounded so nervous!
Shhh! Keep it down! Ugh!
Sorry...
Well, we were bf-gf for a while and then `he` dumped `me` because I was 'too bossy'!
Anyway, it took a long time to get over it, but eventually I did.
Yeah...
And trust me... After what he did, I taught him the real definition of the word `bossy!`
I don't think I'm that kind of person.
Oh you're totally not!
You know what you need to do? Play up the sad, single guy thing until some hot girl feels bad enough to make out with you!
But I don't know any hot girls!
Well, sure you do!
Right, name one...
Meanwhile, in the Auto-Shop, a special package arrives for Ryan!
She's finally here! It's time for a twenty-four hour electric-powered make-out session!
Ryan unveils his robot girlfriend.
What? A computer mounted on a mannequin?
Greetings, boyfriend. Please take me shopping.
What? That's not hot at all!
I want to go somewhere nice for dinner.
No way!
Don't you love me?
Shut up, robot girlfriend! Ben didn't even make you look good.
Now you've hurt my silicon feelings. Please say something nice about me.
How do I turn you off?
Does not compute. I'm going to cry unless you say something nice about me.
No!
Initiate robo-tears in three... Two... One...
Okay! Fine! Your, um... Monitor thing looks nice.
Do you mean it?
I'm going to kill Ben.
I knew you loved me. We've been together for... one minute and twelve seconds. Did you get me a present for our anniversary?
No! I didn't get you a present!
When can we go shopping?
Not now, okay? I'm supposed to hang out with Travis later...
You're always spending time with `the guys.` You never have time for `us.`
Enough! I'm... I'm putting my foot down!
There's a sale.
Fine! Let's go shopping!
I love you.
Yeah, whatever.
Tear sequence initiating...
I mean... I love you too, robot girlfriend.
Awww... Ryan got his robot girlfriend, even if it wasn't quite what he had in mind! Hope you enjoyed the return to school!
